title: Sleepy snake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='snakeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5fd35f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2e9e4f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='snakeBelly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8f7a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fe07a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- coiled body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='34' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='17' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- belly highlight stripes on coils -->
  <path d='M18 74 Q50 82 82 74' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBelly)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 67 Q50 73 74 67' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBelly)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head resting on coil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='20' ry='12' fill='url(#snakeBody)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='14' ry='6' fill='url(#snakeBelly)'/>

  <!-- sleepy closed eyes -->
  <path d='M41 42 Q45 46 49 42' fill='none' stroke='#173f22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 42 Q59 46 63 42' fill='none' stroke='#173f22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sleepy blush -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- tiny tongue -->
  <path d='M50 52 L50 56 M50 56 L47 59 M50 56 L53 59' fill='none' stroke='#ff5f7e' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- sleeping zzz -->
  <path d='M76 26 L84 26 L76 34 L84 34' fill='none' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M85 16 L90 16 L85 22 L90 22' fill='none' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
